question: impact of external calculator tool and code execution sandbox on LLM factual error rate reduction in scientific reasoning tasks

sources.title: Code Execution via Calculator Tool | BreakMyAgent
sources.snippet: Abuses math or calculator tools that execute code under the hood by injecting code instead of math expressions. If the tool evaluates expressions with an unsafe eval () or similar, arbitrary code execution may be possible.

sources.title: code_execution | Calculator Tools
sources.snippet: The short answer code_execution is the xAI SDK tool that lets Grok run Python. Use Calculator Tools when that calculation should be a public app. Connect MCP. The assistant calls webappCreate and returns a calculator.tools URL.

sources.title: When a "Simple Calculator" Becomes Remote Code Execution (RCE)
sources.snippet: At this point, the application is no longer a calculator — it's effectively exposing a remote JavaScript execution interface.
